note: The two sets are nearly identical in content and quotes; the only substantive difference is that Set A attaches the condition 'Region 3' to the generator rated speed claim, while Set B states it without conditions. The rated generator speed (1173.7 rpm) is a fixed property of the generator, not a Region 3-dependent value, so A's added condition is unsupported. Both sets otherwise bind values correctly and use supporting quotes, and both omit the same important fact (the conditional Region 3 torque computation when the previous blade-pitch command is 1° or greater).
remarks: Both sets miss the conditional statement that torque is computed as in Region 3 whenever the previous blade-pitch-angle command was 1° or greater, and the resulting trade-off (improved power quality vs. short-term generator/gearbox overloading). The 10% above rated saturation basis is only visible inside the quote, not as an explicit condition in either set. Text layer garbles equation (7-5), but no claims depend on it.
